headline: 'SOS' from the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce: 'Small and Medium Enterprises Risk Dying Out'
summary: The Arcadia Chamber of Commerce warned that small and medium-sized enterprises are tending to die out under ongoing challenges and accumulated financial burdens.
why: Small and medium-sized enterprises make up most businesses in Greece and are a key source of employment, so their distress matters for the regional economy.
